from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CompanyDebtMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Represents the financial data extracted from a single 10-Q filing required to compute debt proportions."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the filing")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    financial_unit: str = Field(description="Unit of the financial figures (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Inputs for Total Liabilities calculation: (Total Assets - Total Shareholders' Equity)
    total_assets: float = Field(description="Total Assets reported on the Balance Sheet")
    total_equity: float = Field(description="Total Stockholders' Equity reported on the Balance Sheet")
    
    # Inputs for Long-Term Debt proportion calculation
    long_term_debt: float = Field(description="Long-term debt value (typically non-current portion)")
    long_term_debt_current_portion: Optional[float] = Field(description="Current maturities of long-term debt, if disclosed separately")
    long_term_debt_line_label: str = Field(description="Exact line item label used for the debt figure in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: List[CompanyDebtMetrics]
